plan.purpose: Computational benchmark only; not an operating-characteristic experiment
plan.observations: Nested fixed nonadaptive on-grid observations; independent Gaussian outcome noise; individual records
plan.dose_order: First 40 indices from two independently permuted 25-point grids, using seed20261001
plan.gp: Independent efficacy/toxicity exact GPs; constant mean; Matern5/2 ARD; known individual noise variances; 120 Adam steps, learning rate0.1
plan.fitting: One unreported-timing warm-up pair at n4; one measured pair for each n; 8 individual fits total (6 measured,2 warm-up)
plan.scoring: One warm-up and five measured repetitions per rule/dataset; fresh Context per call; no score reuse; same fitted models for all four rules within each dataset
plan.primary_timing: Context construction plus registered full-vector scorer; includes gate and tMSE preparation; excludes fitting and file I/O
plan.gp_prediction_cache: Fitted-GP prediction caches are warmed by the per-rule warm-up, retained across scoring calls; score/Context objects are fresh
plan.execution: Serial CPU, one PyTorch intra/inter-op thread; numerical-library thread limits1
plan.scope_limit: Three prespecified data sizes and one stratum; timings are not full-trial runtimes and not a representative distribution over adaptive trial states
